faults.title: Power-steering problems
faults.description: The first-generation Tiguan can have steering-system trouble that may involve its control unit or larger steering assembly. Listen for unusual noises and have unexpected steering behaviour checked promptly.

faults.title: Front-suspension rattles
faults.description: Rattling from the front suspension is a reported Mk1 Tiguan weakness. Check for noise over uneven roads and ask a workshop to identify the worn or loose part before repair.
